verdict.rationale: Codex is operated by prompting it in natural language. The docs describe asking it to explore code, plan and make changes (codex-docs-9), delegating work to subagents on request (codex-docs-13), passing prompts with images (codex-docs-12), requesting follow-ups (codex-docs-5), and starting tasks from Slack threads or issues (codex-docs-2). Hands-on community reports corroborate prompt-driven use (codex-comm-14, codex-comm-15, codex-comm-18), though some users report weaker prompt adherence with smaller models or general struggles (codex-comm-15, codex-comm-3). Missing for 10: an explicit first-party description of the natural-language command interface itself (it is mostly implied through task examples), and consistent independent evidence of reliable instruction-following.
